key.name: gap-size
key.description: Margin in pixels around maximized windows on edges without a panel.

key.name: use-custom-margins
key.description: Set each screen edge separately instead of one gap size.

key.name: custom-margin-top
key.description: Pixels between a top panel and the window. With no panel, pixels from the top of the screen.

key.name: custom-margin-bottom
key.description: Pixels between a bottom panel and the window. With no panel, pixels from the bottom of the screen.

key.name: custom-margin-left
key.description: Pixels between a left panel and the window. With no panel, pixels from the left of the screen.

key.name: custom-margin-right
key.description: Pixels between a right panel and the window. With no panel, pixels from the right of the screen.

key.name: skip-panel-edges
key.description: Do not add a gap on edges that already have a reserved panel/work-area inset (Dash to Panel, top bar, etc.).

key.name: tiling-shell
key.description: Apply a margin between tiled windows through Tiling Shell's inner gaps.

key.name: tiling-shell-gap
key.description: Margin in pixels between tiled windows when Tiling Shell compatibility is enabled.

key.name: peek-blur
key.description: Experimental: blur the desktop wallpaper in the margin around maximized windows. Uses a separate wallpaper clone and does not modify Blur My Shell.

key.name: peek-blur-radius
key.description: Gaussian blur radius for the peek margin. Larger values are cheaper thanks to downscaling.
